premises.text: Online gaming is static: anonymous tags, no control over who you play with, and women avoid voice chat
premises.evidence_span: You don't know who you're playing with. You're dealing with anonymous gamer tags that come in and out of games

premises.text: Rich profiles, blogs, pictures, chat, and videos enable deep social engagement before/during play
premises.evidence_span: We offer rich user profiles, deep engagements with other users, including profiles that include blogs, pictures, and you're able to chat online, you can post your videos

premises.text: Payer pays to play; play date earns money—monetarily addressing supply and demand
premises.evidence_span: The payer, as we call it, pays, and the play date actually makes money playing that game

premises.text: Respectful ratings and invites give play dates control over who they accept
premises.evidence_span: she can actually see my respectful rating, which is what I've earned by playing other play dates before me

premises.text: Flash games in UI plus option to play console games off-platform
premises.evidence_span: We have a number of Flash games available on our UI, or you can go off and play console games on your own

premises.text: Game developers can earn more than traditional ad CPMs via the platform payout model
premises.evidence_span: we can pay out much greater than the CPMs you get in traditional advertising models

value.text: A fun, inviting, secure place to meet gamers and play them online—like buying someone a game
value.evidence_span: we are a fun, inviting place to play. We're secure. You can come in, meet gamers, and play them online

It offers greater control of your environment and monetarily addresses the issues of supply and demand
